verdict.rationale: There is no explicit bulk-operation feature (such as multi-select archive or toggle) in the evidence. What exists are adjacent mechanisms: export/import of feature flags, segments defined once and reused across any number of flags, release templates applicable to any flag, and an Admin API with comprehensive programmatic access that would let an agent script batch changes. missing for 10: documented bulk actions on many flags at once (bulk enable/disable/archive/tag), bulk API endpoints, MCP-driven batch operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
